responsibility: This file implements libgccjit’s internal logging facility. It defines gcc::jit::logger as a reference-counted sink for indented line-oriented trace output, initializes logs with GCC version information, flushes eagerly for crash debugging, and implements log_user ownership management for contexts, results, and tempdirs. It owns the runtime behavior of diagnostic trace logging rather than the API surface or compiler replay itself.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-logging.h, which declares logger, log_scope, log_user, and macros, this same-stem source file implements the runtime logging behavior itself: reference counting, indentation, message emission, flushing, and logger ownership transitions.
